newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-ENGLAND LOOK TO LIONS COACH FOR HELP.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-ENGLAND LOOK TO LIONS COACH FOR HELP.

text.p: England cricket officials are looking to successful British Lions rugby union coach Ian McGeechan to motivate Michael Atherton's team ahead of the fourth test against Australia later this month.

England, who crashed to a 268-run loss to Australia in the third test at Old Trafford on Monday, will hold a two-day team-building seminar immediately before the next test at Headingley starting on July 24.
Former England rugby captain Will Carling's company Insights will run the seminar.
England's cricket chiefs want McGeechan to use the same motivational techniques he used to inspire the Lions to their recent 2-1 test series victory over South Africa.
Selectors on Tuesday named the same side beaten in the third test, plus spinner Phil Tufnell for the next test in Leeds.
Devon Malcolm, Mike Smith, Ashley Cowan, Adam Hollioake and Ben Hollioake have also been invited to the seminar.
David Graveney, England's chairman of selectors, said the meeting was planned before the third test loss.
The six-test Ashes series is tied at 1-1.
